method: Production vs uninstrumented archived candidate alternate order; instrumented candidate runs afterward. 2 sizes, 4 independent changes, 7 trials = 56 cases. Base scenes built first. totalMs=candidate, controlMs=production, diagnosticMs=instrumented candidate. Extra timers/counters and third execution perturb JIT/GC/lower caches; difference not pure timer correction. Phases inclusive, signature comparison included in hit/miss residual. Snapshot/mutation outside timing. Two complete equality comparisons per case. No browser/GPU/frame/native claim.
